Definition: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pass on or away, pass through, pass by, go through, grow up, change, to go on from; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to pass on quickly; 1a2) to pass away (vanish); 1a3) to come on anew, sprout again (of grass); 1a4) to pass through; 1a5) to overstep, transgress; 1b) (Piel) to cause to pass, change; 1c) (Hiph); 1c1) to change, substitute, alter, change for better, renew; 1c2) to show newness (of tree)
